newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids slip.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids slip.

text.p: Spring wheat cash bids slipped on Monday in line with lower MGE futures, dealer said.
MGE May futures fell two cents to end at $4.00-3/4 a bushel.
Dealers noted slow movement. "Farmers are still hanging in there. They want a cash price of $4.15 for hard red winter wheat, 13 percent," a Montana dealer said.
Regarding spring wheat, the dealer said producers were holding off on plantings, which were expected to be down.
Also, authorities increased flood preparations in the upper Midwest Monday in anticipation of warmer weather causing record-high snow packs to melt.
